name: Pending Passkey Registration
summary: Begins and completes passkey attestation while the identity remains inside PendingIdentity.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == pending and pending-identity-flow == passkey and credential-proof == challenge-issued and durable-identity == absent

setup: Begin a passkey PendingIdentity and issue a single-use registration challenge.

inputs.description: Valid WebAuthn attestation from the secure component.

postconditions.expression: credential-proof == passkey-proved and pending-identity-status == resolution-required and durable-identity == absent
